explication: Columba is an Android Reticulum messaging and voice application. Its principal user flow is creating or selecting an identity, connecting through a supported network interface, and exchanging messages or calls; conversations, contacts, and identity data are persisted locally. The README also documents location sharing, offline maps, NomadNet browsing, propagation, and identity backup. The map includes these documented capabilities, but sampled source is limited, so most feature links are cited to the README rather than inferred as internal call chains.
